correctness.rationale: The root rank L is uniform 0..n-1. Conditioned on L the two extreme depths are independent, distributed as A_L and A_{n-1-L}, with A_0=0, A_k=1+sum_{j=2}^k Bernoulli(1/j). The record-indicator law and coupling imply expectation of any nonconstant increasing depth function is monotone, nonconstant in subtree size. Reverse Chebyshev covariance with the opposite-sized subtrees is strictly negative; indicators of thresholds a,b<=n-2 give strict quadrant inequality. The conditional mixed moment is n^-1 sum_{l=0}^{n-1} H_l H_{n-1-l}, giving Cov=1-H_n^(2) via harmonic generating functions; finite exact permutation enumeration for n=2..6 independently reconfirmed every quadrant and moment. Central root ranges epsilon n..(1-epsilon)n yield independent Bernoulli sums with means log n+O_epsilon(1) and variances log n+O_epsilon(1); triangular-array CLT plus endpoint probability <=2epsilon proves joint independent normals. The boundary n=2 covariance -1/4 is included.
residual_risks: Proof of strictness concerns nonconstant increasing functions over the full finite attainable support, not arbitrary nonmonotone functions.
Finite exhaustive n<=6 verifies but does not establish all n or joint CLT.
